source_row.acip: KUN SLONG NI, BSAD PAR 'DOD PA'O, , SBYOR BA LA SBYOR BA PO NI, RANG GIS BYAS PA'AM GZHAN BYED DU 'JUG PA GNYIS GANG BYAS KYANG 'DRA STE, SBYOR BA'I NGO BO NI MTSON NAM, DUG GAM, RIG SNGAGS KYI SGO NAS SBYOR BA BYAS PA LA SOGS PA GANG YANG RUNG BA'O, ,
source_row.wylie: kun slong ni, bsad par 'dod pa'o, , sbyor ba la sbyor ba po ni, rang gis byas pa'am gzhan byed du 'jug pa gnyis gang byas kyang 'dra ste, sbyor ba'i ngo bo ni mtshon nam, dug gam, rig sngags kyi sgo nas sbyor ba byas pa la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'o,
source_row.english: Here are the different aspects of the undertaking. As far as the one who undertakes the deed, it doesn't matter whether you perform it yourself, or get someone else to do it for you, it's all the same. The essence of the undertaking is when the deed is initiated, either with some kind of weapon, or poison, or spell, or whatever the case may be.

spans.rationale: The first undertaking noun introduces the category discussed in the paragraph. It cannot own motivation, which appears only in preceding370 English.

The complete agent noun denotes the person undertaking the deed. PO supplies the agent role, licensing one who; the supplied article and deed object remain outside. The whole glossary entry says deed, which does not describe this agent and is not adopted as a literal definition.
The undertaking member supplies the verb within this agent noun and is unique and strictly tighter on both sides. The full SBYOR BA record directly includes undertakes.
RANG identifies the agent acting personally and owns yourself. It does not duplicate the supplied subject you or later for you.

The action verb is rendered perform in the self-performance alternative. The complete BYAS PA family supports perform; the past stem is used in the general condition, with the following entire PA'AM kept separate.
The entire nominalized disjunctive syllable is retained as the alternative linker. It owns the first or after yourself; no internal apostrophe-AM is split off.

The other agent is rendered someone else. This local contrasting role licenses the indefinite person expression; the unrelated auto-aligned a bodhisattva record is explicitly rejected as evidence for this occurrence.
The doing verb belongs to the other-agent alternative. It owns only do, not the supplied object it or beneficiary for you.
The complete complement-linking particle is realized as to in get someone else to do. It is distinct from the lexical causative verb.

The causative verb makes another engage in the act, rendered get in this local get-someone-to-do construction. Full JUG PA supports get and to induce; BYED DU JUG PA also gives do it, but its broader construction does not erase the separate get exponent.

The sameness predicate owns same in the final equivalence statement. The earlier negative it-does-not-matter paraphrase and all remain distributed across the whole comparison; no nonexistent Tibetan negator is invented.
The later undertaking noun is the dependent of essence and owns the second English undertaking.
The whole nature/essence compound directly supports essence; it does not refer to the undertaking agent.
The means is a weapon. ACIP MTSON converts to the stored mtshon, which is preserved; no spelling normalization or supplied kind-of noun is banked.
This disjunctive introduces poison after weapon and owns that exact or.
This is the physical means poison, distinct from the mental-poison compound in370.
This later disjunctive introduces spell after poison, not either earlier or.
The established complete compound directly attests spell. Neither member has a strictly tighter English exponent inside this single word, so no degenerate member is added.
The whole instrumental expression directly attests with and scopes over weapon, poison and spell. The preceding genitive KYI stays outside rather than being split into an invented separate exponent.

The complete undertaking-done construction is recast as initiated. SBYOR BA directly includes initiated, while BYAS PA contributes performance; keeping the whole construction avoids two claims on one verb. The English subject deed and passive is remain outside.

spans.tib: la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'o
spans.rationale: The complete inclusive closing construction is rendered by the closing or whatever gesture. LA SOGS PA directly supports or whatever and GANG YANG RUNG BA any; the combined source is not split into competing claims on the same indefinite. The case-may-be support remains unwrapped and the final bound ending is preserved.
